newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Minas Gerais to sell Cemig preferred shrs.
newsitem.headline: Minas Gerais to sell Cemig preferred shrs.

text.p: Brazil's Minas Gerais state will sell a three percent preferred stake in its power firm Cemig for an estimated 150 million reais, a company official said.

The auction of the preferred shares will probably take place next week before the sale of convertible debentures for a 33 percent voting stake in the company, said Luiz Fernando Rolla, assistant to Cemig's chief financial officer.
The debentures will be auctioned off in a block sale on April 25 for a minimum price of 60.37 reais per debenture to a strategic partner.
Rolla said four foreign investors have shown interest in Cemig's 33 percent stake: U.S. Southern Co, Chile's Enersis SA, France's EDF and U.S. AES Corp
EDF and AES, along with other investors, hold control of power distributor Light Servicos de Eletricidade SA, which was privatized in May last year.
